scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @purrpose/shared build && prisma generate && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @purrpose/shared build && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @purrpose/shared build && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @purrpose/shared build && prisma generate && vitest run
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter @purrpose/shared build && prisma generate && tsx prisma/seed.ts
